'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**Thirty-three people are killed as [[Allied Democratic Forces]] gunmen carries out a [[Mass murder|mass execution]] of civilians at the [[Virunga National Park]] in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-north-kivu-rebels-adf-extremists-387968084aa553fd37415996ccfe5ed1 (AP)]
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2023 attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq and Syria]]
***The [[United States]] launches [[airstrike]]s on facilities associated with [[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] in eastern [[Syria]] in response to rocket attacks on its [[military base]]s. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/11/12/politics/syria-strikes-lloyd-austin-joe-biden-iran-iraq/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-carries-out-two-air-strikes-against-iran-aligned-groups-syria-official-2023-11-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[South Africa]]n Foreign Minister [[Naledi Pandor]] urges the [[International Criminal Court]] to issue an [[arrest warrant]] for [[Israel]]i prime minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]], calling on the [[Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court|prosecutor]] to investigate [[war crimes]] and [[crimes against humanity]], and [[genocide]]. [https://www.news24.com/news24/politics/parliament/pandor-calls-for-international-criminal-court-to-issue-arrest-warrant-for-benjamin-netanyahu-20231107 (News 24)] [https://www.timeslive.co.za/sunday-times/opinion-and-analysis/opinion/2023-11-12-arrest-netanyahu-and-halt-the-gaza-genocide/ (Sunday Times (South Africa))]
***The [[United Nations Development Programme|UN Development Programme office]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] is shelled, with reports of a significant number of deaths and injuries. Office chief [[Achim Steiner]] says that "[[civilians]], civilian infrastructure and the inviolability of [[UN]] facilities must be always protected". [https://www.dawn.com/news/1788681/un-office-in-gaza-shelled-reports-of-casualties-and-injuries-undp-chief (Dawn)]
***The United Nations says that several hospitals in Gaza have been directly hit, and that "hospitals are explicitly entitled to specific protection under [[international humanitarian law]]", as Israel intensifies its shelling and ground attacks around hospitals in [[Gaza City]] and northern Gaza. [https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/hostilities-gaza-strip-and-israel-flash-update-36-enarhe (OCHA)] [https://www.tbsnews.net/hamas-israel-war/no-way-evacuate-babies-safer-hospital-gaza-health-ministry-737998 (''Business Standard'')]
***The cardiac ward of the [[Al-Shifa Hospital]] in Gaza City, is destroyed by Israel's ground offensive and the hospital's intensive care unit is severely damaged by Israeli army bombing. The [[World Health Organization]] (WHO) says that there are reports that people who fled the hospital "have been shot at, wounded and even killed" and calls for a humanitarian [[ceasefire]], saying that they are concerned about the safety of workers and patients who remain inside the hospital. The WHO also says that it has lost communication with its contacts inside the hospital. [https://www.thejournal.ie/netanyahu-israel-gaza-hospital-6220799-Nov2023/ (The Journal)] [https://www.emro.who.int/media/news/who-loses-communication-with-contacts-in-al-shifa-hospital-in-gaza-amid-reports-of-attacks.html (WHO)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/12/israel-gaza-war-live-israeli-army-surrounding-al-quds-hospital (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/12/israel-gaza-war-live-israeli-army-surrounding-al-quds-hospital (Al Jazeera 2)]
***[[Australia]]n Foreign Minister [[Penny Wong]] calls on Israel to stop its attacks on hospitals, expressing concern about the number of civilian deaths from Israel's assault on Gaza, saying that "international humanitarian law does require the protection of hospitals, of patients and of medical staff". [https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/foreign-minister-penny-wong-calls-on-israel-to-cease-attacks-on-hospitals-20231112-p5ejbs.html (''Sydney Morning Herald'')]
***[[Palestine|Palestinian]] [[Ministry of Health (Palestine)|Minister of Health]] [[Mai al-Kaila]] says that Israeli forces "are not evacuating people from hospitals; instead, they are forcibly evicting the wounded and patients onto the streets, leaving them to face inevitable death". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/12/israel-gaza-war-live-israeli-army-surrounding-al-quds-hospital (Al Jazeera)]
***[[UNICEF]] spokesperson Toby Fricker has said the situation inside hospitals across the Gaza Strip is a tragedy, noting how [[premature babies]] inside Al-Shifa Hospital are struggling to stay alive due to the lack of electricity and water. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/12/israel-gaza-war-live-israeli-army-surrounding-al-quds-hospital (Al Jazeera)]
***Thirteen people are killed  and many others are injured in an attack on a [[residential building]] in eastern [[Khan Younis]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/13-palestinians-killed-25-injured-in-israeli-airstrike-on-house-in-southern-gaza/3051694 (Anadolu Agency)]
***More than 11,100 Palestinians have been killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza since the war began with Israeli forces currently intensifying their raids in the [[West Bank]] with the number of raids increasing to about 40 per day in the past week. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/12/israel-gaza-war-live-israeli-army-surrounding-al-quds-hospital (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[Palestine Red Crescent Society]] announces that the [[Al-Quds Hospital]] in Gaza City is no longer operational due to a lack of fuel and a [[power outage]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/gaza-s-al-quds-hospital-out-of-service-due-to-lack-of-fuel-power-outage/3051608 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***An [[Israel Electric Corporation]] employee killed and with six of the fatality's colleagues, seven IDF members and 8 Israelis injured by Hezbollah anti-tank missile and mortar attacks.[https://jpost.com/breaking-news/article-772861 (JPost)]
***IDF launches a drone strike at a Hezbollah crew attempting to launch antitank missiles at [[Metula]]. [https://jpost.com/breaking-news/article-772861 (JPost)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**At least six people are killed and nine others are injured by gunfire between [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|soldiers]] and pro-government [[Mai-Mai|militiamen]] near [[Goma]], [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/six-killed-in-east-dr-congo-after-soldiers-pro-state-militants-clash/7351589.html (AFP via VOA)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Geneina]]
***The death toll from clashes in [[Geneina]] increases to 1,300 people, with more than 2,000 injured. The [[UNHCR]] also confirms that around 8,000 people have fled to [[Chad]] from Geneina in the past week. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2023/11/10/corpses-on-streets-sudans-rsf-kills-1300-in-darfur-monitors-say (Al Jazeera)] [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/800-sudanese-reportedly-killed-attack-darfur-town-104822667 (ABC News)]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***Heavy fighting is reported in [[Jabal Awliya]], south of [[Khartoum]], as the [[Rapid Support Forces]] attempt to capture the [[Jebel Aulia Dam]]. [https://sudantribune.net/article279293/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]
	
'''Disasters and incidents'''
*[[2023 Uttarakhand tunnel collapse]]
**An under-construction tunnel collapses in [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]], trapping at least 40 construction workers under the debris. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1788702/at-least-40-indian-workers-trapped-in-tunnel-collapse-rescue-worker (AFP via ''Dawn'')]
*Five [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. service members]] are killed in a helicopter crash in the [[Eastern Mediterranean]] during a routine training exercise. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-67398905 (BBC News)]
*Six people are killed in a fire at a [[bungalow]] in [[Hounslow]], [[West London]], [[United Kingdom]]. The fire is believed to have started during [[Diwali]] celebrations which led to nearby trees catching on fire. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/hounslow-fire-deaths-police-london-b2446374.html (''The Independent'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021–2023 North Korean missile tests]]
**The [[defense minister]]s of [[Japan]], [[South Korea]], and the [[United States]] agree to initiate a [[Real-time data|real-time]] [[data sharing]] mechanism to monitor [[North Korea]]'s [[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction|missile]] tests. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/11/13/world/asia-oceania/us-south-korea-japan-to-share-north-korea-missile-warning-data/1919561 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[International reactions to the Gaza war|International reactions to the 2023 Israel–Hamas war]]
**The [[Biden administration]] contacts [[Israel]]i officials for clarification over comments Israeli prime minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] made stating that Israel will not agree to give up security control of Gaza, after [[United States|US]] [[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] suggested that the [[Palestinian Authority]] should take over control of Gaza once the conflict is over. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/12/israel-gaza-war-live-israeli-army-surrounding-al-quds-hospital (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Médecins Sans Frontières]] says that Gaza hospitals "will become a morgue if action isn't taken right now" as "electricity in a hospital is a lifeline and we know without it patients die". They also called for the "bloodshed" to end "immediately with a ceasefire or at the bare minimum a medical evacuation of patients". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/12/israel-gaza-war-live-israeli-army-surrounding-al-quds-hospital (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[Tim Scott 2024 presidential campaign]]
***[[List of United States senators from South Carolina|U.S. Senator]] [[Tim Scott]] suspends his campaign for the [[2024 Republican Party presidential primaries|Republican nomination]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tim-scott-drops-out-2024-race-b9cc8fbeba57a123789d8d0484164e38 (AP)]
*Hundreds of thousands march in [[Spain]] to protest Prime Minister [[Pedro Sánchez]]'s law granting judicial amnesties in exchange for political support to retain power. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/11/12/world/europe/spain-protests-sanchez.html (New York Times)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 African Football League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Mamelodi Sundowns F.C.]] wins the inaugural [[African Football League]] after they defeat [[Wydad AC]] in the [[2023 African Football League final|final]]. [https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/african-football-league/articles-video/mamelodi-sundowns-stage-comeback-to-clinch-african-football-league-title-2023-11-12 (beIN Sports)]
*[[2023 Chinese Professional Baseball League season#Taiwan Series|2023 Taiwan Series]]
**In [[baseball]], the [[Wei Chuan Dragons]] defeat the [[Rakuten Monkeys]] to win the [[Taiwan Series]] in seven games, capturing their fifth championship and their first since reforming as a team in 2019. [https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2023/11/13/2003809086 (''Taipei Times'')]
